section.p: This section describes the process of accessing the REST API. Only the admin can generate the API keys and endpoint.

ol.li: Create an ADI OtoSense™ SMS account. For more information, see the SMS Account Requirements in the Developer Commissioning Guide.
Check the Wi-Fi configuration. For more information, see Network Requirements in the ADI OtoSense™ Installation guide.
Generate the API keys and endpoints. For more information, see the API keys and endpoints in the Developer Commissioning Guide.
